sketches.mechanism: Automatic Reference Counting deallocates an object when its last strong reference leaves scope, and any weak references to it are automatically set to nil.
sketches.resonance: What is not held strongly enough vanishes without argument, leaving only an empty place that still has a name.

sketches.mechanism: Nothing is Kotlin's bottom type: a function returning Nothing never produces a value, yet its result is accepted wherever any type is required.
sketches.resonance: The promise that never arrives can fit every expectation because it never has to become anything.
sketches.draft:
fun wait(): Nothing = wait()
val proof: Int = wait()
val home: Boolean = wait()

sketches.mechanism: An entry call on a task blocks until the task reaches a matching accept statement; if no accept is ever executed, the caller waits forever.
sketches.resonance: A call cannot complete itself; it must be met by another life at exactly the doorway it names.
